edges.reason: Owned constructor initializes owner from msg.sender.
Constructor writes owner state variable.
_newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender against owner before state change.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner for the authorization check.
acceptOwnership sets owner = newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
totalSupply returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using native subtraction.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] in its subtraction.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer decrements the caller's own balance using msg.sender.
to parameter is the recipient in transfer.
tokens parameter determines the transferred amount in transfer.
transfer credits the recipient via safeAdd.
transfer debits the sender via safeSub.
transfer writes both sender and recipient entries of balances.
transfer performs SafeMath balance arithmetic flagged as an arithmetic operation.
The arithmetic operation updates the balances mapping.
approve keys the allowance mapping on msg.sender.
spender parameter is the approved address in approve.
tokens parameter is the approved amount in approve.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom decrements the caller's allowance via msg.sender.
from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount in transferFrom.
transferFrom writes balances for from and to.
transferFrom decreases the allowed mapping.
transferFrom performs SafeMath balance and allowance arithmetic.
tokenOwner parameter indexes allowed in allowance.
spender parameter indexes allowed in allowance.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall keys the allowed mapping on msg.sender.
spender parameter is both the approved address and the target of the external call.
tokens parameter is the approved amount in approveAndCall.
data parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval call.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
approveAndCall invokes an arbitrary external contract via receiveApproval, enabling reentrancy.
msg.sender is passed as the from argument of the external receiveApproval call.
The attacker-controlled spender is the callee of the unsafe external call.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
tokenAddress parameter selects the external token contract to call.
tokens parameter is the amount forwarded to the external transfer call.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on an arbitrary token address.
tokenAddress is the target contract of the unsafe external transfer call.
